name: qkd_kvs_ctl_mu1-mu1-COMMIT
purpose: MU-KV-BOOT 10-19: MU 1 kit of qkd_kvs_ctl (Qwen ROM 4 users).  Bench tb_mu_kv_boot: the real boot path (qkd_static_kv_boot_dispatch_mu) loads the compiler-emitted 471-word MU layer image (mu_calendar GAP[4][36]) and the MU ownership roots into the kit top; 4 users run 2 frames per the GAP table; every lprg pulse equals the compiled event list and user 0 equals the single-user original; mutants: single-user image, GAP block not forwarded, user-0 gap, colliding table.
